messages.Viteza animației schimbă numai scara tim: Animation speed changes only the time scale. Each step remains 0.02 simulated s. Ideal spring, no friction.
messages.De la deformare la lucru mecanic și ener: From deformation to work and energy
messages.Reglajele și tragerea corpului pregătesc: Adjustments and dragging prepare a new experiment with v₀ = 0.
messages.1 s real = 1 s simulat. Resort ideal, fă: 1 real s = 1 simulated s. Ideal spring, no friction.
Drag the body or use the ← → keys.
messages.Un resort orizontal fără masă acționează: A horizontal massless spring acts on a body on a frictionless surface. The Ox axis points right. Deformation x = l − l₀ is measured from the undeformed length l₀ = 0.60 m. Compression means x < 0.
messages.Semnul minus indică o forță orientată sp: The minus sign indicates a force toward the undeformed position. k is measured in N/m, x in m, F in N, m in kg, t in s, energy and work in J, power in W.
messages.La deformare lentă, F_ap = kx echilibrea: During slow deformation, F_ap = kx balances Fₑ. The area between the F_ap(x) line and the axis from 0 to x represents stored energy. Force increases gradually: work is not F_final · x. During compression, applied force and displacement are both negative, so work from 0 to x remains positive.
messages.Forța aplicată devine zero. Energia trec: Applied force becomes zero. Energy continuously changes between elastic and kinetic forms. At x = 0, force is zero but speed can be maximal. The analytical solution uses the same state for the body, graphs and readouts.
messages.Intervalul ±0,20 m este o alegere didact: The ±0.20 m interval is an educational choice, not a universal elastic limit. Proportionality is assumed throughout. We do not model friction, plastic deformation, failure, buckling or spring mass. The proportional limit differs from the elastic limit. Weight and the normal force balance.
messages.Reglarea parametrilor implică intervenți: Adjusting parameters involves external intervention and starts a new setup. Energy conservation applies to each free oscillation after release. The body’s momentum alone is not conserved because the fixed support exerts force through the spring.
messages.În pregătire, fixează k = 100 N/m și măs: In setup, set k = 100 N/m and measure F_ap at x₀ = 0.05 m, 0.10 m and 0.20 m. Calculate the force–deformation graph slope using the equation below. Compare energies: doubling deformation doubles force but quadruples energy. Repeat for compression.
messages.Problema 1 · Lucrul forței elastice: Problem 1 · Work done by the spring
messages.Un resort cu k = 100 N/m trece de la x =: A spring with k = 100 N/m moves from x = 0.10 m to x = 0.20 m. Energy increases from 0.50 J to 2 J. Spring work is −1.50 J; during slow deformation, the hand does +1.50 J.
messages.Cu k = 100 N/m, m = 1 kg și x₀ = 0,10 m,: With k = 100 N/m, m = 1 kg and x₀ = 0.10 m, E = 0.50 J and T ≈ 0.6283 s. At T/4 the body crosses x = 0 with v = −1 m/s. At T/8 the spring power is +5 W. Check the direction of motion and the U ↔ K exchange.
messages.La x < 0, ce semn are energia elastică?: For x < 0, what is the sign of elastic energy?
messages.La trecerea prin x = 0 în oscilația libe: When crossing x = 0 during free oscillation, must the body be at rest?
Zero force does not imply zero velocity.
messages.Cât lucru efectuează mâna la întindere l: How much work does the hand do when slowly stretching from 0 to x?
messages.Forța medie este jumătate din forța fina: Average force is half the final force.
